response.sql: WITH circuit_stats AS (SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) as avg_round, COUNT(*) as race_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) as share FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), ranked AS (SELECT circuitId, avg_round, race_count, share, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) as dr FROM circuit_stats) SELECT circuitId, avg_round, race_count, share FROM ranked WHERE dr <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, circuitId

assumptions.assumption: All races have a non-NULL circuitId; the average round is computed across all races for each circuit regardless of season
